name: tokenslayer
description: Semantic Structural Cache — Slash LLM token usage by 40-95% with AST-driven code skeletons

chatParticipants.name: tokenslayer
chatParticipants.description: Get compact structural summaries of your code. Analyze files, directories, or your entire workspace with AST-driven skeletons that save 40-95% of tokens.

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analyze the active file or workspace

commands.name: workspace
commands.description: Generate a structural map of the entire workspace

languageModelTools.name: tokenslayer-structural-summary
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get a compact AST skeleton of source code (class hierarchies, function signatures, exports, type relationships). Call this BEFORE read_file for: 'how is X structured', 'where is Y defined', 'show me the class hierarchy', 'what does the module export', 'map this directory', 'workspace overview'. Returns 5-10% of the token cost of reading raw files. Skip this tool when: you already have the exact file + line range, the file is under ~20 lines, the target is a JSON/config/markdown file (no code structure to compact — read it directly), or the user explicitly asked for raw source. For implementation edits: call this first to locate the symbol, then read the specific line range you need to modify — do not read entire files cold.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Analyzes source code and returns a compact structural skeleton with class hierarchies, function signatures, and type relationships — saving 40-95% of tokens.

filePath.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to analyze. If omitted, analyzes the active editor file.

scope.description: Scope of analysis. 'file' for a single file, 'directory' for all files in a directory, 'workspace' for the full workspace, 'dependency-chain' for the file and its local imports (BFS). Defaults to 'file'.

verbosity.description: Level of detail. 'minimal' = signatures only. 'standard' = signatures + first-line docs. 'detailed' = signatures + docs + imports. Defaults to 'standard'.

targetModel.description: Target LLM model for BPE-aware layout optimization. E.g. 'gpt-4o', 'gpt-4', 'claude'. Optimizes indentation and whitespace to reduce token count.

languageModelTools.name: tokenslayer-apply-patch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Apply structural patches to source code using node IDs from a previous tokenslayer-structural-summary call. Each skeleton element is tagged with /* NODE:id */ markers. Use this tool to replace, insert after, or delete code blocks by referencing their node ID. Supports dry-run mode to preview diffs before applying.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Apply structural code patches using node IDs from skeleton analysis. Supports replace, insert_after, and delete operations with dry-run preview.

patches.description: Array of patch operations. Each patch has a nodeId (from /* NODE:id */ markers), action (replace/insert_after/delete), and optional content.

nodeId.description: The node ID from a /* NODE:id */ marker in the skeleton output.

content.description: The new code content (required for replace and insert_after).

dryRun.description: If true (default), returns the unified diff without modifying files. Set to false to apply changes.

languageModelTools.name: tokenslayer-expand-node
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Expand a TokenSlayer skeleton node ID back to its full source code. Structural summaries tag every element with NODE:<id> (or EXPAND:<id>) markers; pass one of those ids to retrieve just that function/class body without re-reading the whole file. Use this after tokenslayer-structural-summary when you need the implementation of ONE specific symbol.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Expands a collapsed skeleton node back to its full source code.

nodeId.description: A node id taken from a NODE:<id> or EXPAND:<id> marker in a structural summary.

tokenslayer.maxFileSizeKB.description: Maximum file size (KB) to analyze. Files larger than this are skipped.

tokenslayer.ignoredPaths.description: Glob patterns for paths to exclude from analysis.

tokenslayer.cacheMaxEntries.description: Maximum number of cached skeletons before LRU eviction.

tokenslayer.targetModel.description: Target LLM model for BPE-aware layout optimization. Leave empty to disable. When set, skeletons are optimized to reduce token count for the specified model's tokenizer.

tokenslayer.dependencyChainDepth.description: Maximum import-follow depth for dependency chain analysis.

tokenslayer.monthlyRequestBudget.description: Monthly cap on combined LLM requests + TokenSlayer tool calls. Shows a progress bar on the dashboard when set (0 = disabled).
